ground.offerFact: Try noticing what is around you right now. It is a short grounding exercise: nothing is recorded or kept.
ground.hint1: Find 5 things you can see. Tap the circle for each.
ground.hint2: Notice 4 sounds around you. Tap the circle for each.
ground.hint3: Notice 3 sensations on your skin. Tap the circle for each.
ground.ring: Tap when you notice one. {{n}} of {{total}}
ground.leaveBody: You can come back to it any time from Me.
ground.endBreath: Take one more slow breath in and out.
ground.endReturn: You can come back to this exercise whenever you want to stop for a moment and be present.
